attributeTransfer.categoricalRule: inherit the unique ancestor value; on an equal-area mixed ancestry tie choose the lexicographically least canonical value and retain every ancestor id
attributeTransfer.faceAncestryRule: each target face records one source panel id and the ordered source-face ids whose closure split produced it
attributeTransfer.massEquation: target lumped vertex mass is one third of incident target rest-triangle mass; target triangle mass is source areal density times target rest area; total target mass is corrected only by assigning the exact fixed-point remainder to the lexicographically least target vertex id
attributeTransfer.numericDomain: integer nanometer panel coordinates for ordering and topology identity; binary64 only inside measured kernels; metric-specific half-even fixed point for portable decisions
attributeTransfer.uvPanelSourceEquation: new vertex attributes equal barycentric interpolation in the selected source panel triangle; existing vertices retain exact values
attributeTransfer.vertexAncestryRule: existing ids retain singleton ancestry; an inserted edge vertex records the ordered endpoint ancestry union and rational split parameter

junctionAndOpeningRules.junctionRule: preserve typed seam-side endpoint incidence; valence-three logical seam junctions remain constraint-graph junctions and never become shared raw-panel vertices
junctionAndOpeningRules.openingRule: preserve every declared opening side as an ordered simple quotient cycle; reject added, missing, repeated, or branched opening edges

renderBindingRebuild.equation: for each render vertex select the containing target panel triangle in canonical panel coordinates by lexicographic face id tie-break, then store bounded barycentric weights summing to one
renderBindingRebuild.fallbackRule: if no containing face exists, select minimum squared panel-space distance with lexicographic face id tie-break and store its clamped renormalized barycentric weights

remeshOperator.closureRule: bisect every face incident to a selected edge; recursively split the opposite edge in any neighbouring face that would otherwise contain the inserted point in its open edge interval
remeshOperator.deterministicPriority: descending integer squared edge length, then panel id, then ordered endpoint ancestry ids, then source face id
remeshOperator.edgeSplitParameter: 1/2 exactly for conforming geometric refinement; semantic seam samples remain governed by the separate normalized-arclength map
remeshOperator.insertedEdgeId: sha256(strategyId || panelId || ordered endpoint ancestry ids || rational split parameter)
remeshOperator.insertedVertexId: sha256(strategyId || panelId || selected edge id || rational split parameter)
remeshOperator.operator: deterministic conforming longest-eligible-edge bisection independently inside each raw panel
remeshOperator.panelBoundaryRule: raw panel boundaries and duplicated seam sides remain distinct; a boundary split is mirrored only through semantic correspondence, never by welding degrees of freedom

representations.rawPanelisedSimulation: distinct orientable manifold-with-boundary panel components with duplicated seam-side vertices
representations.renderAndFallback: literal indexed connectivity with explicit equivalence and ancestry ids for intentional UV, material, and hard-normal splits
representations.semanticSeamQuotient: logical sewn connectivity induced only by typed ordered seam correspondences

seamCorrespondence.easeEquation: for each locked semantic sample q, map sA=q/(N-1) through the declared monotone piecewise-linear ease profile e(sA); locate the unique half-open target interval [sB_j,sB_j+1), using the closed final interval at s=1; weights are (1-t,t)
seamCorrespondence.intervalCoverage: ordered half-open intervals cover [0,1] once, with the final interval closed at 1
seamCorrespondence.orientationRule: same orientation uses sB=e(sA); reversed orientation uses sB=1-e(sA)
seamCorrespondence.partitionRule: all interpolation weights are bounded in [0,1] and sum to one within the frozen fixed-point unit
seamCorrespondence.sampleAuthority: preserve the existing finite-compliance semantic constraint sample identities and count; remesh boundary vertices do not multiply seam springs
seamCorrespondence.seamLaw: unchanged finite-compliance XPBD distance law, compliance, rest-gap/ease semantics, and normalized-arclength sampling authority from PHY1 seam-support v3

strategyClass: seam-sequence-preserving conforming panel remesh with duplicated seam degrees of freedom and rebuilt transfer/binding ancestry

transferRebuild.collisionAdjacency: rebuild target vertex-face and edge-edge adjacency from target indexed faces
transferRebuild.constraintRule: rebuild stretch, shear, bend, seam, and support constraints from target rest geometry and unchanged material/seam laws
transferRebuild.selfCollisionExclusion: exclude only literal target adjacency plus exact stitched semantic neighbours; broad-label exclusion is forbidden
